description: Results of one of the user's watch quizzes (made here, in the web app, or on a boost): state (live / paused / ended), how many people started, answered, got it right, ran out of tries, or used their second try, how each question did, and the credits billed so far. Free, read-only. A question most viewers miss is usually ambiguous — say so. 'paused' with credits left means the user paused it; otherwise the balance ran out.

quiz_id.description: The quiz id from create_watch_quiz (or boost_post's watch_quiz.campaign_id).

name: get_watch_quiz_results
title: Get watch-quiz results
